html:
Reminder: Unauthorized Absence Letter

Date: {{ frappe.utils.format_date(frappe.utils.nowdate(), "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}

Employee Name: {{ doc.employee_name }}

Employee ID: {{ doc.employee_id }}

Designation: {{ doc.designation }}

Branch Name: {{ doc.branch_name }}

Dear {{ doc.employee_name }},

You are absent from {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.issue_occurrence_date, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }} without prior permission or intimation.

We have sent you a letter dated {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.issue_reported_to_hr, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }} asking you to join duty by {{ frappe.utils.format_date(frappe.utils.add_days(doc.date_of_1st_letter, 3), "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}, but you did not report to work.

You are therefore called upon to report on duty latest by {{ frappe.utils.format_date(frappe.utils.add_days(doc.date_of_reminder_letter, 3), "dd-MMM-yyyy") }} or within 3 days of receipt of this letter along with an explanation for your unauthorized and continuous absence, failing which it shall be presumed that you are no longer interested in the employment and have abandoned the same.

Accordingly, the management shall initiate necessary and appropriate action including termination of your services.

For, Sahayog Multistate Credit Co-operative Society Ltd.

{% set hr_stamp = frappe.db.get_single_value("Sahayog HR Setting", "common_hr_stamp") %} {% if hr_stamp %} {% endif %}

Authorized Signatory
name: Reminder Unauthorized absence
